name: Balatonfűzfő (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Balatonfűzfő: a green shield with a white willow tree and yellow stars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
